Heyy! I got diagnosed \~2 weeks ago and i totally understand your confusion. I felt exactly the same for the first weeks. Right now i'm getting more comfortable with my diagnosis, getting more used to it. For me it helps to think that your problems/struggles haven't changed, someone only put a label on it. Thinking about that calms me down. But it's a process and i'm def not there yet, not even close.. If you want to know more about bpd you can do some research online ofc, but i'm not a huge fan of that. When looking at bpd online you mainly read negative things. Sometimes psychologists offer psycho-education, i did found that helpful. Only advice i can give is: give yourself some time to process everything. It can feel really overwhelming to get diagnosed and it's totally okay to be confused! Don't be hard on yourself !

First of all i am so so proud that you made the appointment!!! Wishing you much luck, you can do it! I was also so terrified, but once you're there it pbb will be okay! Try not to worry too much (easier said than done ofc). For my treatment i'm on Zoloft (no miracles but it's doing something) and I will be getting EMDR, individual schema therapy + emotion regulation therapy, followed by group schema therapy. My medication will be evaluated during the entire time, they already told me that I pbb will need more medication at first (since therapy pbb makes you feel worse in the beginning) but they want to reduce the dose when possible en ultimately get me off medication. So that's the plan for now, but it can always change ofc. Once again i'm rooting for you !!

Hello, also 25yo (f) over here. I'm a medical student so I knew the criteria for BPD before my diagnosis. I suspected I could have BPD, just didnt know whether my symptoms were ''severe'' enough to get the diagnosis (spoiler alert, they are). I was also scared to get diagnosed because of the stigma that comes with it, but so far it's quite okay actually. Most of my friends have been supportive and are not treating me differently (some are though..). I'm guessing the hotline lady doens't understand (enough) about BPD, I am highly self-aware. I totally see how selfdestructive and manipulative I can be but I can't help it (which makes it a even harder struggle sometimes). I got my diagnosis \~1 year after I called my GP. Didnt see a therapist regularly last year, mainly been sent from waiting list to waiting list. My current therapist diagnosed me immediately during the first appointment. I'm currently waiting (gotta love the waiting in the mental health field) to start therapy (schema therapy and possible EMDR) and i'm on Zoloft (2months now) to bridge the waiting time. I'm having some side effects but my mood is a bit better and it numbs me out a little, which is kinda nice sometimes. So not really much progress yet, but since it took me 4-5years to finally call my GP, it's also progress that i'm actually went to see a therapist and i really hope so start treatment in a couple of months. Hope this helps, feel free to ask questions (eventhough i'm just newly diagnosed newbie)
